level1_sampling: take every frameskip-th state independently within each episode
normalization: zero mean and unit variance per episode and scalar dimension
entity_pooling: sum weighted-frequency numerators and spectral-power denominators across dimensions and episodes
paper_disclosure: Appendix F specifies amplitude normalization, level-1 sampling, and pooling over episodes, but does not publish the FFT weighting or exact pooling formula; periodogram weighting is selected because it matches the reported Ant per-episode ratio statistics much better than magnitude weighting.
